root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: `payloadLen >= sizeof(gre1_header)` before `new GREv1Layer(payload, payloadLen, this, m_Packet)`.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: When `greVer == GREv1`, IPv4 GRE parsing must only construct `GREv1Layer` from `payload` when the backing slice is large enough for a full `gre1_header`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable IPv4 GRE branch reuses `GreLayer::getGREVersion()`'s 4-byte admission result and constructs `GREv1Layer` from a 5-byte slice. The fixed code adds `GREv1Layer::isDataValid(payload, payloadLen)` at this exact site, so the same branch is guarded until `payloadLen` reaches the 8-byte GREv1 header boundary.

nodes.state: At the `payloadLength` store, `sizeof(getGreHeader()->payloadLength)` is 2 while only `m_DataLen - getHeaderLen()` bytes remain beyond the basic GRE header. On the crashing witness this is `2 > 1`, so the 2-byte store overruns the 5-byte GREv1 backing slice.

edges.relation: The same short `payloadLen` used to construct `GREv1Layer` becomes the layer's `m_DataLen` at `GREv1Layer::computeCalculateFields()`, so the sink reserializes the unchanged GRE slice that violated the constructor precondition on the original witness.
